crossRefs.note: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted…
He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas”…
So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,
“Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?”

translations.web: The woman hurried and ran, and told her husband, saying to him, “Behold, the man who came to me that day has appeared to me,”
translations.bsb: The woman ran quickly to tell her husband, “Behold, the man who came to me the other day has reappeared!”
translations.kjv: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.
translations.asv: And the woman made haste, and ran, and told her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.
